title: Calibration Engineer - Drivability
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Calibration Engineer - Drivability Product Development**

**Role and Responsibilities:**

* · Responsible for complete EMS software calibration and validation.
* · Responsible for calibration data management, calibration integration & release to customer.
* · CAN database verification / mapping during project development phase.
* · Environmental trials support for customer to meet the vehicle performance targets through EMS calibration optimization in varying environmental condition.
* · Guarantee the compliance of calibration process workflow with the standards defined by Client.
* · Customer Interaction on daily / weekly basis to understand vehicle / bench validation status and SW bugs.
* · 9 Customer reported defects needs to be validated and JIRA ticket to be created for internal / external tracking purpose.
* · 10 Customer interface for problem solving in industrialization, necessary support to internal and external customers.
* · To work on the new technology like BS-6 / Hybrids / AMT / DCT.
* · Travel to customer location to support development activities.

**Minimum Educational Qualification Required:**

* · Degree in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering, with a preference for an M.Tech in Automotive Engineering.
* · Minimum Experience Required: 4-9 years

**Skills Required**

**Technical Skills**

* · Expert level experience Engine control system or Transmission Control System
* · Basic Knowledge of System Calibration
* · Basic knowledge Base calibration
* · Expert Level Knowledge Start and Idle calibration
* · Expert Level Transient, component protection, CAN interface, AMT and DCT inteface integration and calibration
* · Expert level knowledge in Take off calibration
* · Basic knowledge In gear accln, dccln, tip in tip out , etc driveability calibration
* · Expert level knowledge ETAS INCA
* · Basic knowledge OBD Daignosis
* · Intermediate knowledge in Matlab
* · Basic knowledge in Vector Tools

**Behavioural Skill:**

* · Communication skills (English and Hindi, with additional languages being preferred)
* · Team-working ability
* · Proactive approach
* · Problem solving attitude
* · Travel and Adaptability

title: Senior Solution Consultant – Global Consulting Hub
description:
**Role Overview**
The Senior Solution Consultant will implement Basware solutions for customers, ensuring compliance with country-specific requirements while delivering seamless AP automation. The role spans design, build, testing, and post-go-live support, requiring advanced implementation expertise, leadership in solution design, and strong customer engagement skills.
  
  
**Compliance Focus**
This role demands a proactive approach to regulatory compliance, ensuring that all configurations, integrations, and workflows meet local statutory requirements such as e-invoicing, e-reporting, and tax mandates. The consultant will act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through compliance best practices while embedding these requirements into the solution design and delivery process.
  
  
**Design Phase**

* Conduct in-depth analysis of existing integration rules, custom formats, and business processes to identify gaps and optimisation opportunities.
* Lead advanced design workshops with multiple stakeholders, covering Directory, E-Invoicing, E-Reporting, and complex Use Cases.
* Define field-level mapping strategies for AP Automation and Network integrations, ensuring scalability and compliance with multi-country mandates.
* Collaborate with technical teams to design API notification flows, E-Reporting content structures, and integration points for custom requirements.
* Provide recommendations for process improvements and automation enhancements based on best practices.

**Build & SIT (System Integration Testing)**

* Configure complex invoicing structures, endpoints, and entity hierarchies in Network and AP Automation for multi-entity organisations.
* Develop and maintain custom import configuration files, mapping new fields and adapting business rules for advanced scenarios.
* Execute comprehensive end-to-end testing, including regression testing for existing customers, and document findings in detail.
* Implement advanced features such as E-Invoicing lifecycle setup, E-Reporting monitoring dashboards, Directory API integrations, and portal entity registration for global compliance.
* Troubleshoot integration issues across multiple systems and propose technical resolutions.

**UAT (User Acceptance Testing)**

* Design detailed UAT plans, including complex test scenarios for multi-country compliance and high-volume transactions.
* Facilitate UAT workshops, guiding customer teams through validation processes and compliance checks.
* Analyse defects, perform root cause analysis, and develop fixes with clear documentation for audit purposes.
* Ensure traceability of requirements from design to UAT for compliance assurance.

**Move to Production**

* Prepare comprehensive Go-Live readiness plans, including risk assessments and contingency strategies.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth cutover and minimal disruption to business operations.
* Validate compliance configurations before production deployment.

**Hypercare (Post-Go-Live Support)**

* Provide expert-level Hypercare support, addressing complex issues related to compliance, integrations, and performance.
* Monitor system behaviour post-deployment, identify recurring patterns, and implement long-term fixes.
* Document resolutions and share knowledge transfer with customer teams for future self-sufficiency.

,
  
  

* Flexible shift timings\*

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 4–5 years of implementation experience in ERP/AP automation projects.
* Advanced understanding of Accounts Payable processes and workflows.
* Hands-on experience with system configuration, data mapping, and integration (APIs, SFTP, REST).
* Ability to lead workshops and manage complex testing phases.
* Familiarity with e-invoicing standards and compliance frameworks.
* Strong documentation and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Basware or similar AP automation platforms.
* Exposure to multi-country implementations with varying compliance mandates.
* Knowledge of digital and custom delivery methodologies.
* Experience with AI tools, frameworks, or applications is considered a strong asset.

We highly value candidates who demonstrate curiosity, a proactive mindset, and a willingness to explore and incorporate AI-driven technologies into their work. We encourage growth in this area and provide opportunities for experimentation and learning.

title: Technical Interpreter
description:
**Job Description – Technical Interpreter (Software Development & Project**

**Management)**

Position: Technical Interpreter (Software Development & Project Management)

Location: Japan

Education: B.Tech in Computer Science (CSE) or Electronics & Communication (ECE)

Japanese Proficiency: JLPT N3/N2 or N1 (Fluent in Japanese & English)

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a Technical Interpreter with expertise in software development and

project management to support communication between Japanese clients and

offshore/global engineering teams. This is a role where the interpreter will actively contribute

to project execution by facilitating discussions, translating technical documents, and assisting

in project coordination. The ideal candidate should have a strong technical background

(B.Tech in CSE/ECE) and Japanese proficiency at N3 or N2 or N1 level.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Interpretation & Translation:**

·      Provide real-time interpretation during technical discussions, meetings, and client

·      interactions.

·      Translate software development documents, specifications, reports, and project

·      requirements between Japanese and English.

·      Ensure accurate and clear communication between Japanese clients and

·      offshore/global development teams.

**2. Technical Communication & Coordination:**

·      Act as a bridge between Japanese stakeholders and offshore engineering teams to

ensure smooth project execution.

·      Support requirement gathering, software architecture discussions, and issue

resolution.

·      Assist in writing and reviewing technical documentation in both Japanese and

English.

**3. Project Management Support:**

·      Collaborate with Project Managers and Engineers to track project progress and

deadlines.

·      Help in reporting project status to Japanese clients and internal teams.

·      Assist in managing client expectations, identifying risks, and ensuring timely delivery

of project milestones.

**4. Client Engagement & Cultural Mediation:**

·      Facilitate cultural understanding between Japanese clients and offshore teams.

·      Help offshore teams understand Japanese business etiquette and work culture.

·      Support client visits, workshops, and training sessions.

**Required Qualifications:**

·      Education: B.Tech in Computer Science (CSE) or Electronics & Communication

(ECE).

·      Experience: Minimum 0-4 years in technical interpretation, software development,

or project coordination.

·      Language Proficiency: JLPT N3 or N2 or N1 (Fluent in Japanese and English).

**Technical Knowledge:**

·      Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC), programming

concepts, and system architecture.

·      Familiarity with software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum,

Waterfall, etc.).

·      Basic knowledge of programming languages (Python, Java, C++, etc.) is a

plus.

·      Project Management Skills: Ability to assist in managing projects, tracking

milestones, and coordinating between teams.

title: Advanced Specialist / Senior Executive - PED
description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as
 **ROLE** 
 .
   

  

 Autoliv is looking for a dynamic
 **Senior Executive \- PED** 
 to join our team and contribute to manufacturing excellence, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a motivated and technically proficient
 **Advanced Specialist / Senior Executive \- PED** 
 to support productivity improvement initiatives, process optimization, automation projects, and manufacturing excellence programs. The role will involve line balancing, time studies, PLC troubleshooting support, new equipment installation, and the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives across the manufacturing environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Support production layout optimization and manufacturing efficiency improvements.
* Assist in PLC logic understanding, programming support, and troubleshooting of automation systems.
* Coordinate with maintenance teams to resolve automation\-related issues.
* Participate in New Product Development (NPD) activities and new equipment installations.
* Implement jigs, fixtures, and Poka\-Yoke solutions to enhance process reliability.
* Prepare and maintain process documentation including Work Instructions (WI), SOPs, PFMEA, and Process Flow Charts.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives such as Kaizen, SMED, Lean Manufacturing, and 5S.
* Conduct Time Studies, Line Balancing, Capacity Analysis, and Work Measurement activities.
* Contribute to IoT, automation, and digital manufacturing initiatives.
* Work with AI\-assisted analytics tools for process optimization.
* Support computer vision applications for inspection and defect detection.
* Assist with robotic integration projects.
* Diagnose automation faults using PLC diagnostic tools, error logs, and communication checks.
* Support systems utilizing industrial communication protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP/RTU, Profibus, and Ethernet/IP.


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
 Technical Competencies
   

  

* Industrial Engineering tools: Time Study, Method Study, MOST, and Work Measurement.
* Basic to intermediate PLC programming knowledge.
* Understanding of PLC architecture, scan cycles, I/O mapping, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes and layout optimization.
* Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and Poka\-Yoke methodologies.
* Understanding of industrial communication protocols.
* Technical knowledge of machines and automation systems.
* Basic understanding of ladder logic and PLC programming concepts.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint. AutoCAD knowledge is preferred.
* Basic understanding of Machine Learning concepts such as classification, prediction, and anomaly detection.


 Behavioral Competencies
   

  

* Customer Focus
* Global Perspective
* Innovation Mindset
* Execution Excellence
* Accountability
* Collaboration
* Ability to Engage and Inspire Others
* Trust Building


 Who You Are
   

  

* A strong team player with excellent communication skills.
* An innovative thinker with a passion for continuous improvement.
* A problem solver with strong analytical and documentation capabilities.
* Someone who enjoys working at the intersection of manufacturing, automation, and emerging technologies.


**Preferred Qualification**
* PLC Basics Certification


**We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.**
 In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.
   

  

**More lives saved – more life lived!**
